data.action: 僵硬坐在长椅双手虚托怀里撒娇小猫，白狐尾局促轻摆，白耳泛红慌张辩解
data.camera: medium shot, seated bench perspective, focus on blushing face, fox ears, and purring cat in lap
data.description: 【星见雅 · 街道长椅被毛茸茸流浪猫扑怀的慌张失措】巡逻间隙幽静的商业街木质长椅上，平日里威严冷傲的对空六课课长，怀里突然轻盈地跳进了一只毛茸茸的圆脸三花流浪猫。面对以太骸兽从不眨眼的拔刀武士，在这一刻却慌乱得手足无措。她双手僵硬地虚托着怀里呼噜呼噜蹭她制服胸口的小猫，巨大蓬松的雪白狐尾在长椅上局促地左右轻摆，双狐耳羞耻后贴，白皙耳廓与脸颊涨得通红。被走过来的你撞见后，她金眸泛起小慌乱，一本正经地强行板起脸辩解——「这、这是针对以太隐蔽生物的近距观察！绝对不是因为觉得它可爱……请不要一直用那种眼神看我！」
data.lighting: 午后树影斑驳的柔和阳光洒在深蓝军服、白狐尾与毛茸茸小猫身上的暖调光晕
data.location: 新艾利都街头绿荫树下木质长椅上
data.promptProse: A delightfully cute and flustering slice-of-life anime illustration of Hoshimi Miyabi from Zenless Zone Zero sitting on a wooden bench in a sun-dappled park. Completely breaking her austere Section 6 chief composure, a fluffy calico street cat has hopped onto her lap and is nuzzling contentedly against her uniform jacket. Her massive snow-white fox tail swishes in anxious, bashful twitches across the wooden slats, and her pointy fox ears are pinned back in pure embarrassment. Holding her gloved hands awkwardly around the purring kitten with an intense crimson blush burning across her face, she looks up with wide golden eyes, sternly denying that she finds it adorable. Soft afternoon tree shadows, warm cinematic daylight, clean anime linework, no text.
data.title: 星见雅 · 街道长椅被毛茸茸流浪猫扑怀的慌张失措
